Updated for the 3 November 2026 game patch (game build 1285601). The game's text box id changed, so after a search the game stayed in typing mode: menus couldn't be backed out of (for example after talking to an NPC), and search results couldn't be clicked. Find now reads that id from the game itself, so a patch can't break this the same way again.
Chests glow through walls again: the smooth silhouette drawing was off after the patch.
A search closed in the same instant it opened no longer leaves the game on its hidden screen with the HUD gone.
find.log no longer grows without end: at 10 MB it rolls over into find.old.log.
Reported bugs fixed: stuck in menus after a search (reported by bigeasier and spirevipp); no glow through walls, and search results couldn't be clicked (reported by Sh1On1).
